bibliography: Rastorgueva, V. S. & Edel'man, D. I. Ètimologičeskij slovar' iranskix jazykov. Vol. 1 (a–ā), 2000; vol. 2 (b–d), 2003; vol. 3 (f–h), 2007. Moscow: Vostočnaja literatura.

extraction.acceptance: OCR lemmas installed only when the fused first lemma agrees with the ABBYY letter skeleton; all other headwords read manually from the headword crops (manual-lemmas.csv)
extraction.diacritics: connected-component geometry: detached flat marks over a/i/u = macron, háček vs acute by top-left ink share (0.16), detached/under-baseline marks under i/u/r = i̯ u̯ r̥, raised glyphs = homonym numerals / ᵛ
extraction.gloss: first quoted Russian gloss(es) of the headword paragraph; English by editorial translation table glosses_en.csv
extraction.headword_detection: hanging-indent (outdented) lines vs a skew-fitted left margin; derivatives are indented
extraction.headword_ocr: pypdfium2 render at native resolution (7.4 px/pt, vol. 3 3.7 px/pt), 2x Lanczos, band-trimmed; tesseract 5 -l script/Latin --psm 7 hocr_char_boxes=1
extraction.text_layer: ABBYY FineReader Russian layer via pdfplumber words (font size used for superscripts)

page_mapping_verification: Tesseract digit OCR of the printed folio strip of every PDF page: 1236 folios read agree with the mapping, 28 partial reads (e.g. "4" for 44), 0 contradictions; no missing or duplicated leaves. Vol. 3 pages are scanned at double size (389x599 pt).
reflex_stage: deferred: no reflex rows installed (see proposals.md)
rights: Copyrighted scan used for research extraction; neither the scan nor page images are checked in.
